problem.summary: The beta SRU adapter incorrectly applied predictive one-SE selection across C ridge alpha and rejected the entire D/M/S branch when the selected over-regularized C refit collapsed the input path.
observed_failure_chain: C prediction variance collapsed below path gate
Gamma_CT contracted to persistence-only zero-delta anchor
W nonlinear candidates received a numerically degenerate latent and were not applicable
A became the only active residual-dynamics stage

best_mean_alpha_counterfactual.finding: Restoring non-degenerate C immediately reactivated W.

v2_1_1_compatible_c_counterfactual.finding: D/M fell back to BEST_ACTIVE_K, S retained compressed C, W selected a nonlinear natural-cubic correction, and A remained active.

publication_hygiene.recommended_confirmation: Apply the same frozen correction unchanged to an untouched task/dataset or a newly designated untouched holdout.
